I've been exploring a SaaS idea for independent veterinary practices — basically a tool that automates post-visit client follow-up and re-engagement to stop practices from losing clients between visits.

I've done a bunch of early work: raw notes from 13 conversations I had with vet practice owners and managers are in `interviews/notes/discovery_interviews_raw.txt`, and I ran a small paid test whose results are in `market_research/raw_data/rat_test_results.txt`. There's also some competitor research and demand data scattered around the workspace.

I need a complete, structured validation report — saved as `validation_report.md` — that walks through whether this idea is worth building. The report should cover all the relevant validation phases, show the actual math and thresholds for each stage, and end with a scored, weighted decision on whether to go ahead or not. Please use all the data I've gathered.
